# ==============================================================================
# Proto-authored actuator library (header-only)
#
# The component is born from actuator/spec_actuator.proto via the
# apex_data.toml manifest's proto_spec reference: .auto/ holds the
# spec-generated structs, dispatch, and the emitted canonical .proto
# (regenerated by make cdef, pinned by check-cdef); inc/ holds the
# once-generated, user-owned stub carrying the actuator logic.
# ==============================================================================

include(apex/All)
apex_module(apex_spec_demo_actuator)

apex_add_interface_library(
  NAME
  ${LIB_NAME}
  INC
  "${INC_DIR}"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.auto"
  DEPS_INTERFACE
  system_core_system_component
  utilities_helpers
  fmt::fmt
)

apex_add_data_manifest(MANIFEST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/apex_data.toml")
